head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: The clipboard write is not awaited, so a failed copy still shows the success toast and leaves a rejected promise unhandled.
reason: Line 278 calls navigator.clipboard.writeText without awaiting and shows the success toast at line 279 regardless, so a failed copy still shows 'copied' and leaves the rejection unhandled.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: The first test's switch assertion does nothing, and the test was not updated for the backup-codes screen.
reason: The first test (lines 44-53) never clicks backup-codes-close after fillOtp, and the un-awaited isChecked() Promise passed to toBeTruthy always passes, so the test does not cover the new step.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: Closing the dialog on the backup-codes step skips onEnable, so the UI shows 2FA as off when it is already on.
reason: The parent's onOpenChange (two-factor-auth.tsx:64) only toggles the open state, so closing on the DisplayBackupCodes step skips onEnable/resetState and the step stays stuck.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: A backup code is used up through an unguarded read-modify-write, so one code can be spent more than once.
reason: Lines 139-156 decrypt the backupCodes read earlier and do an unconditional prisma.user.update, so two concurrent requests with the same code can both succeed.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: The show/hide password button in the shared PasswordField is no longer reachable by keyboard.
reason: tabIndex={-1} at Input.tsx:49 on the shared PasswordField takes the show/hide toggle out of keyboard reach app-wide, which is an accessibility regression.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: Log message in the 2FA disable endpoint says "backup code login".
reason: Only the wording of the console.error message at disable.ts:50; a log-text remark, not a defect.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: The hard-coded type="password" stops the new PasswordField's show/hide toggle from working.
reason: Input.tsx sets type at line 36 and spreads {...props} after it at line 39, so the type="password" passed at EnableTwoFactorModal:176 overrides the toggle.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: The missing-backup-codes message points users to a settings option this change doesn't add.
reason: About the wording of the missing_backup_codes locale string, which is a message-text remark.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: The minimum schema has a bogus computed key and strips every field except access_token, including the expiry.
reason: `[z.string().toString()]` evaluates to "[object Object]", so the minimum schema reduces to access_token plus one bogus key, and z.object strips expiry/scope in sync mode.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: In sync mode this returns a raw fetch Response, but several callers expect a different shape.
reason: refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response in sync mode, while Google (`res?.data`), the Zoho apps (`tokenInfo.data.error`) and HubSpot (`expiresIn`) expect a parsed object.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: In sync mode Google reads `res.data` from a fetch Response, which is undefined.
reason: Line 94 `res?.data` is undefined on a fetch Response, so `token.access_token` throws when sync is enabled.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Google credential key is overwritten with the safeParse result instead of the token data.
reason: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the safeParse result `{success,data}`, and line 97-100 stores that whole object as the credential key.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: `prisma` is used here, but this file never imports it.
reason: The Salesforce file has no prisma import; the global `prisma` is only assigned when NODE_ENV !== 'production' (packages/prisma/index.ts:58-60), so production throws a ReferenceError.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: HubSpot treats the sync-mode fetch Response as a `HubspotToken`.
reason: In sync mode the HubSpot refresh gets a fetch Response, so `expiresIn` is undefined (expiryDate becomes NaN) and the Response object is saved as the key.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Salesforce refreshes tokens on every construction, then builds the connection with the old access token.
reason: getClient refreshes unconditionally on every construction and then passes the stale `credentialKey.access_token` to jsforce.Connection at line 106.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Zoho Bigin sends the credential ID as the user ID.
reason: Line 93 passes `credentialId` as the userId argument, which refreshOAuthTokens sends as calcomUserId.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Credential id is passed where the user id belongs.
reason: Same defect: credentialId is passed where refreshOAuthTokens expects the userId (lines 92-93).

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Zoho CRM reads `.data.error` from a fetch Response in sync mode.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: The webhook secret is checked with a non-constant-time comparison.
reason: Lines 24-27 compare the secret header with `!==`, which is not constant-time, on an endpoint that can write credentials for any user.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: `appStoreMetadata` is indexed by app slug, but it is keyed by directory name.
reason: appStoreMetadata is keyed by dirName (_appRegistry.ts:17 uses app.dirName; e.g. the zoom slug lives under the zoomvideo dir), so indexing it by app.slug returns 404 for apps whose slug differs from their dir.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: Two concurrent webhooks can both create a credential (race between find and create).
reason: findFirst followed by create without a transaction or unique constraint can create duplicate credentials, and the parse/decrypt calls at lines 31/57 throw uncaught 500s.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: A placeholder refresh_token can overwrite the stored real refresh token.
reason: Office365's schema has `refresh_token: z.string().optional()`, so the placeholder "refresh_token" is spread over the real stored token and persisted.

head: 9fde0e906897cc0f4f71793f647dd629faba3317
title: The request to the sync endpoint carries no secret, so the endpoint cannot authenticate Cal.com.
reason: The code comment 'Customize the payload based on what your endpoint requires' shows that authenticating the sync request is intentionally left to self-hosters.

head: c790227e0cda780e6fea9bb03af27948d9e286b9
title: The retryCount delete branch isn't limited to SMS reminders.
reason: A repo search shows the only writers of workflowReminder.retryCount are in scheduleSMSReminders.ts (lines 184/195), so non-SMS reminders stay at the default 0 and the `retryCount > 1` branch cannot delete them.

head: c790227e0cda780e6fea9bb03af27948d9e286b9
title: A failed update inside the catch block stops the whole cron run.
reason: The new `await prisma.workflowReminder.update` inside `catch` (lines 190-197) has no handler, so an error there (e.g. P2025 when the reminder was deleted at the same time) escapes the for loop and stops the rest of the batch, where the old catch only logged.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: `sed -i ''` only works with macOS/BSD sed and breaks on Linux.
reason: Line 68 `sed -i '' -E ...` is BSD-only syntax; GNU sed treats '' as the script and fails, yet line 73 still reports success.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Unrelated change to how the dev cron script runs.
reason: The PR description explicitly lists the ts-node→npx tsx dev:cron change; it's a scope remark, not a defect.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Calling updateMany with an empty data object probably won't bump SelectedCalendar.updatedAt.
reason: CalendarService.ts:1024 passes `{}` to updateMany; Prisma only adds @updatedAt when write args are non-empty, so this is a no-op extra query, and the UI reads CalendarCache.updatedAt instead.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Existing cache rows get the migration time as `updatedAt`, so old caches look freshly updated.
reason: Commit 5fd11f9 explicitly chose DEFAULT NOW() to give legacy rows a valid timestamp; this is an intended design decision.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Delete cache fails for credentials the user doesn't own directly (delegation or team credentials), even though the UI offers it.
reason: Whether delegation credentials ever have CalendarCache rows under a credentialId not owned (userId) by the user can't be verified from the code shown; the plain-Error part duplicates finding 8.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Unrelated webhook tunnel script that writes to a .env path relative to the working directory.
reason: A local dev helper script added deliberately (commit b634834); the scope and relative-path remarks are not defects in the feature.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: The cache timestamp is always formatted with the "en-US" locale.
reason: Line 89 hardcodes `new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...)` while the surrounding text is localized, so non-US users see US date order.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: The generated warning comment no longer matches the SQL below it.
reason: Stale generated comment in migration.sql lines 1-6 is a comment-wording issue only.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Access-denied error is a plain Error, so the client gets a 500 instead of NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN.
reason: deleteCache.handler.ts line 25 throws a plain Error, which tRPC maps to INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR instead of NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Added SelectedCalendar fields (updatedAt, googleChannelId) that nothing in the PR uses.
reason: Extra selected fields are an unused-leftover/style remark with no failure.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: The DB default `NOW()` may not match the Prisma schema, which would cause migration drift.
reason: schema.prisma line 1719 declares `updatedAt DateTime @default(now()) @updatedAt`, matching the migration's DEFAULT NOW(), so no drift.

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: `import()` calls run as soon as the module loads, so nothing is deferred.
reason: Each `import("./x")` in the object literal (lines 3-30) runs as soon as the module is evaluated, so all 28 apps still load right away and nothing is deferred.

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: An async `forEach` callback moves `getCalendar` errors outside the try/catch.
reason: `getCalendar` is now async and ends with `new CalendarService(credential)` (line 22), so a constructor error becomes a rejection inside the `forEach(async ...)` callback that the surrounding try/catch never sees.

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: An async `forEach` callback moves `getCalendar` errors outside the try/catch.
reason: This is the same pattern as in vital: `forEach(async ...)` with `await getCalendar(...)` at line 128 moves constructor errors out of the try/catch and leaves them as unhandled rejections.

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: `getCalendarCredentials` now returns `calendar` as an unawaited Promise.
reason: Every caller of `getCalendarCredentials` (calendar.ts:83, viewer.tsx:340/415) passes the result straight to `getConnectedCalendars`, which awaits `item.calendar` inside its try (line 48); line 124 uses only the integration type.

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: An async `forEach` callback drops `getCalendar` errors as unhandled rejections.
reason: At line 553, `forEach(async ...)` with `await getCalendar(...)` turns a `CalendarService` constructor error, which used to propagate to the handler, into an unhandled rejection nothing observes.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: Second `downsize` definition replaces the width/height version and breaks existing callers.
reason: The second `def self.downsize(from, to, dimensions, opts={})` at line 149 replaces the 5-arg version, and app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb:14 still calls `OptimizedImage.downsize(path, path, 100, 100, opts)`, which will raise ArgumentError.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: Client size check now ignores the per-type site settings, including attachments.
reason: Line 182 replaces `Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb']` with a fixed `10 * 1024` for every type, so the client check no longer follows max_attachment_size_kb for attachments.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: URL downloads are capped at a hardcoded 10 MB for every type.
reason: Line 55 hardcodes `10.megabytes`, so URL uploads above 10 MB fail on sites whose settings allow more; the `rescue nil` gives a nil tempfile and line 72 then fails on `tempfile.size`.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: The 413 error message always says the limit is 10 MB.
reason: It duplicates the line-246 point already in finding 1 and otherwise only concerns the wording of the 413 message, which never reflected the web server's real limit before either.

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: Rewriting the file in place may not be seen through the open tempfile handle.
reason: Whether the open tempfile descriptor sees the shrunk file depends on how ImageOptim's optimize_image! writes its output (rename vs in-place), which I cannot verify from the repository.

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: `unsubscribe` crashes when the user has no TopicUser row.
reason: Line 105 uses `TopicUser.find_by` and line 107 calls `tu.notification_level` with no nil check, so a user without a row (for example someone who got a mention or a forwarded link) gets a NoMethodError and a 500, while `TopicUser.change` would create the row.

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: `unsubscribe_link` now needs `%{unsubscribe_url}`, but only notification emails pass it.
reason: The only place that sets `add_unsubscribe_link: true` is user_notifications.rb:294, and it also passes `unsubscribe_url: post.topic.unsubscribe_url` there; the digest builds its own link and does not set this option.

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: A GET request changes notification settings with no CSRF protection and no confirmation step.
reason: The `unsubscribe` action changes and saves the notification level on a plain GET with no token, so a cross-site embed or a link prefetcher can trigger it, and each reload lowers the level one more step.

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: Calling tu.save! directly skips the MessageBus notification_level_change publish.
reason: `tu.save!` at line 113 skips the `MessageBus.publish(... notification_level_change ...)` that `TopicUser.change` does at topic_user.rb:113, so the user's other open clients keep showing the old level (the claim about UserActionObserver is weaker, but the MessageBus part holds).

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: raw_html cook method publishes unsanitized remote HTML on the forum origin (stored XSS).
reason: post.rb:133 returns raw unchanged for raw_html posts, and topic_embed.rb:22 sets that cook method on unfiltered feed/Readability HTML.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Protocol-relative URLs are rewritten to wrong same-host paths.
reason: topic_embed.rb:64/70 `start_with?('/')` matches `//host/...`, and the `sub(/^\/+/, '')` then puts the embed host in front of the CDN host.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Disqus import loses its --category option and created_at, and aborts when a fetch fails.
reason: The switch to TopicEmbed.import_remote at disqus.thor:148 is the author's own redesign of the importer, and 'not described in the request' is a remark, not a defect.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: The "requires feed_polling_url" and "requires embed_by_username" specs cannot fail.
reason: site_settings.yml:355 defaults feed_polling_enabled to false, so poll_feed.rb:15 short-circuits and these specs pass whatever the URL/username checks do.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Kernel#open on a URL from a setting allows command execution.
reason: poll_feed.rb:29 calls Kernel#open on a setting value, which runs a shell command for strings starting with '|'.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Feed items with no content crash the whole poll.
reason: poll_feed.rb:35 calls i.content.scrub with no nil guard, so RSS items with only a description raise NoMethodError and abort the loop.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Embed URL is put into raw HTML without escaping.
reason: topic_embed.rb:13 puts url into `<a href='#{url}'>` without escaping, inside a raw_html post that is never sanitized.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: `embed.post` can be nil (post deleted), so the update path crashes.
reason: lib/trashable.rb:5 adds a deleted_at default_scope to Post, so embed.post is nil for trashed posts and PostRevisor.new(nil).revise! at line 35-36 crashes.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Already-released migration edited to add `force: true`.
reason: Applied migrations are not re-run in normal operation, so adding force: true to the old create_top_topics migration causes no failure in practice.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Anonymous callers can create unlimited topics by changing the embed URL.
reason: topic_retriever.rb:26 keys the throttle on the exact embed_url, so URL variants on the allowed host each trigger a fetch and a new topic.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: The throttle uses SETNX then EXPIRE as two separate calls, so a crash in between leaves a key that never expires.
reason: topic_retriever.rb:27-28 run setnx and expire as separate calls; a failure between them leaves a key with no TTL that blocks retrieval of that URL for good.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: The "is 404 without an embed_url" spec passes because of the host check, not the missing `embed_url`.
reason: embeddable_host defaults to '' and embed_controller.rb:25 raises InvalidAccess in the before_filter, so the spec never reaches params.require(:embed_url).

head: 267d8be1f556ed59639ced396c885bb44586da19
title: `include_website_name` lacks the `?` suffix, so the serializer never uses it as a filter.
reason: Line 153 defines `include_website_name` without `?`, unlike the `include_card_image_badge_id?` convention next to it, so the filter never runs and `website_name` is always sent.

head: 267d8be1f556ed59639ced396c885bb44586da19
title: Host comparisons are case-sensitive, so mixed-case website URLs never match the instance domain.
reason: Nothing lowercases the host: `UserUpdater#format_url` (user_updater.rb:106) only adds `http://` and lines 138-149 compare hosts as typed, so a mixed-case host never matches the instance domain.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: totalPages counts one page too many when user_count is an exact multiple of limit.
reason: Line 13 `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` gives an extra empty page whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit, so showingLast is false on the real last page.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: The public members endpoint takes limit and offset from the client without bounds.
reason: Lines 22-23 pass params straight into `.limit/.offset` with no clamping; a negative offset makes Postgres raise (500), and the client divides by meta.limit.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: Add/remove member requests have no error handler, so failures are silently ignored
reason: removeMember/addMembers in group.js only chain `.then` and the controller ignores the promise, so a 422 or other failure is never shown to the admin.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: The public group members page now shows only the first 50 members and has no way to page.
reason: The server now defaults to limit 50, and group-members.js.es6 only calls findMembers() at offset 0 while the public template has no paging controls, so groups over 50 are cut off.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: Adding a user who is already a member returns a 500 error.
reason: Group#add is `self.users.push(user)`, which inserts immediately on a persisted group, and group_users has a UNIQUE (group_id,user_id) index, so re-adding raises a 500.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: Overlapping findMembers responses can leave the wrong page displayed
reason: findMembers writes the shared model from whichever response arrives last and never ignores stale responses, so a fast next/previous click can show the wrong page.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: The automatic-group test for remove_member sends PUT, but the route only accepts DELETE.
reason: Controller specs call the action directly, so `xhr :put` still exercises the automatic-group check; the verb mismatch is test style, not a defect.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: Removing a member with users.delete skips GroupUser callbacks and raises an error for non-members.
reason: GroupUser (app/models/group_user.rb) has no destroy callbacks, only a counter cache, so nothing is skipped; a 404 when removing a non-member is reasonable, not a bug.

head: 7562f37880367411a62304bcdcdc178bced23906
title: The denial cache key is ambiguous when names contain '_'.
reason: cache.go:31 joins name and parent with '_', and UIDs can contain underscores, so name=a_b/parent=c and name=a/parent=b_c produce the same key, and a cached denial for one wrongly denies the other until the cache entry expires.

head: 7562f37880367411a62304bcdcdc178bced23906
title: The denial cache key leaves out the identity type, so a denial can carry over to a different kind of caller.
reason: pkg/services/user/identity.go:296-298 gives both anonymous and the render service the ID "0", and service.go:116 leaves the identity type out of the denial key, so a denial cached for anonymous also denies the renderer.

head: 7562f37880367411a62304bcdcdc178bced23906
title: A cached denial blocks access to a resource that is created or granted after the denial.
reason: service.go:153-155 caches every denial for shortCacheTTL (30s) and lines 116-121 read it before the permission cache and the DB with no invalidation, so a denial cached before the creator's permission row exists blocks the creator for 30s, the problem this PR is meant to fix.

head: 7562f37880367411a62304bcdcdc178bced23906
title: The denial-cache test seeds a deny, so it would pass without the denial cache.
reason: checkPermission at service.go:558 only allows when scopeMap[...] is true, so the seeded value `false` at service_test.go:982 denies access anyway and the test would pass even if the denial cache were never read.

head: 1cab4143d443c33079566f6ca36931eb8468159f
title: The empty-expr filter now runs before interpolation, so queries that interpolate to an empty string are no longer dropped.
reason: Lines 49-52 now check the raw `query.expr` before `applyTemplateVariables`, so an expr like `$query` that resolves to an empty string is no longer filtered out (the old code filtered after interpolating), and nothing in `splitQueriesByStreamShard` removes it before it is sent.

head: 1cab4143d443c33079566f6ca36931eb8468159f
title: Interpolating before `querySupportsSplitting` may hide `$__range` from the guard that stops those queries from being split.
reason: `applyTemplateVariables` (datasource.ts:1113) removes `__range`, `__range_s` and `__range_ms` from the variables before calling `templateSrv.replace` so the backend fills them in, so `$__range` is still in the expr when `isQueryWithRangeVariable` checks it.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: The limit check and the insert are not atomic, so concurrent new devices can exceed the limit.
reason: CreateOrUpdateDevice runs CountDevices (line 110) and the upsert (line 149) in separate sessions with no lock, so concurrent new devices at limit-1 can all insert and push the count past the limit.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: Device tagging now runs synchronously on every anonymous authentication.
reason: client.go line 44 now calls TagDevice inline on the request ctx even when deviceLimit is 0. That removes the old goroutine, its recover() and its background timeout, so every install pays for the write on the auth path, not just ones with a limit.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: The query is prepended to the captured `args` inside the session closure, so a retry corrupts the arguments.
reason: withDbSession wraps the callback in retryer.Retry with retryOnLocks (session.go:127). A retry on SQLite busy/locked therefore runs line 84 again and puts the query in front of the captured args a second time.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: A zero RowsAffected can come from an existing device, not just a new one, so known devices get locked out.
reason: Grafana's MySQL connection string sets clientFoundRows=true (sqlstore.go:287), so RowsAffected counts matched rows and an existing device does not get 0.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: TagDevice now returns every tagging error, and the error is ignored or fatal depending on the caller.
reason: Apart from tests, the only caller of TagDevice is client.go:44. It fails only on ErrDeviceLimitReached and logs any other error, so no caller treats a transient DB error as fatal.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: Field type is inferred as `undefined` instead of `number | undefined`.
reason: This is a typing nit that follows the file's existing convention for undefined-initialized fields (e.g. googleAnalyticsId: undefined, tokenExpirationDayLimit: undefined), and nothing goes wrong at runtime.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: New int64 parameter on ProvideAnonDBStore may break wire injection if the provider is still registered.
reason: Nothing in the wire graph uses AnonStore any more (impl.go builds the store itself and passes it to NewAnonDeviceServiceAPI directly), and wire only resolves the inputs of providers it actually needs, so the leftover provider at wire.go:374 does not break generation.

head: bbd8c507cdf56f6b884373809e0b24abd4a2353d
title: The constructor no longer takes the AnonStore through DI, and `ProvideAnonDBStore` now needs an int64 that the wire graph cannot supply.
reason: The only consumers of anonstore.AnonStore are impl.go and the api, which gets a.anonStore, so no other injected store skips the limit, and wire does not fail because of the unused provider at wire.go:374.

head: f3317b329b4eb8fd96f99dd86525bc4a22d20248
title: `enableSqlExpressions` reads the feature flag, then ignores it, and its variable name says the opposite of what it holds.
reason: Both branches of `enableSqlExpressions` at reader.go:194-200 return `false`, so SQL expressions are always off regardless of the flag, which is what the PR sets out to do. The complaint about the inverted `enabled` name and the unused flag check is a naming and style remark about a possible future edit, not a defect in this change.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Async legacy writes use the request context, so they get cancelled when the handler returns.
reason: Lines 51/110/135/163 build the goroutine context from the request ctx, which is cancelled once the handler returns; nothing in the package uses context.WithoutCancel, so the async legacy writes can be cancelled.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: A failed unified-storage Create is recorded under the legacy-storage metric.
reason: Line 45 calls recordLegacyDuration after a failed d.Storage.Create, so the storage failure is counted under the legacy metric.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: A successful Delete is recorded with the object name in the kind label.
reason: Line 106 passes `name` where every other call passes options.Kind, so the kind label gets object names.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: A failed unified-storage Update is recorded under the legacy-storage metric.
reason: Line 129 calls recordLegacyDuration after a failed d.Storage.Update, so the storage failure is counted under the legacy metric.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: The legacy DeleteCollection result is recorded under the storage metric.
reason: Line 166 records the result of the async Legacy.DeleteCollection with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Legacy write failures are now silently dropped.
reason: The goroutines at lines 55-56, 112-113, 139-140 and 165-166 only record a metric and never log the error, which the old code did log.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: The legacy Update re-applies the original objInfo instead of the object stored in unified storage.
reason: Line 139 passes the raw objInfo to Legacy.Update; the old code and mode2 (line 298) wrap it in updateWrapper so legacy gets the object unified storage stored.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Legacy Update re-applies the original update instead of writing the object unified storage stored.
reason: Duplicate of finding 6: same line 139, same raw-objInfo-instead-of-updateWrapper issue.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Delete puts the base logger into the context instead of the enriched one.
reason: Line 97 uses klog.NewContext(ctx, d.Log) instead of the enriched `log`, unlike every other method, so downstream logs lose the name, kind and method fields.

head: 3214b188de808fdb0fff335556b686f1b0a63218
title: Passkey check is inverted: it now needs a user, so first login never gets conditional passkeys.
reason: Line 161 returns true only when `user != null`, the reverse of the old `context.getUser() == null` check, so a first login with no user selected never calls fillContextForm, and the tests expect the webauth form there.

head: 3214b188de808fdb0fff335556b686f1b0a63218
title: Call to a no-argument `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` that the shown code does not define.
reason: A repository-wide search finds only `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user)` at UsernamePasswordForm.java:160 and no version without arguments, so the no-argument call at UsernameForm.java:47 will not compile.

head: 79d11c4890cc4792e3dc3535af59e4e5f7a2739d
title: ES384 and ES512 tests sign with a P-256 key, so they never test their own curves.
reason: Line 42 makes a single default (P-256) EC key that all three tests share, so ES384/ES512 never sign with their own curves. The long-form DER length branch (sequence over 127 bytes, only reached with P-521) in the new ASN1Encoder/ASN1Decoder is never tested.

head: 79d11c4890cc4792e3dc3535af59e4e5f7a2739d
title: Startup no longer fails when several server crypto providers are on the classpath; a tie is now picked silently.
reason: The PR description says choosing among several providers by order() is the intended design. The Quarkus server sets its provider explicitly from FipsMode via CryptoIntegration.setProvider (KeycloakRecorder.java:214), so the FIPS mix-up the finding describes doesn't come from detectProvider.

head: 79d11c4890cc4792e3dc3535af59e4e5f7a2739d
title: New abstract `order()` method breaks every existing `CryptoProvider` implementation outside this PR.
reason: All four in-repo implementations (DefaultCryptoProvider, FIPS1402Provider, WildFlyElytronProvider, AuthzClientCryptoProvider) add order(), and the PR description says making it a required method on CryptoProvider was the chosen approach.

head: 62bf98939eda58f0d0a1a41a58aa6d4ecdc24dba
title: Documented command overrides the user's configured feature set with only `rolling-updates`.
reason: This is about the wording of an example in the docs. update-compatibility.adoc already tells users to include all of their configuration options (lines 72 and 87), and its line 49 says the tool does not yet check configuration changes, so the claimed wrong rolling/recreate verdict cannot happen today.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text.
reason: Line 101 of the Lithuanian account bundle now has the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:".

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Simplified Chinese bundle now contains Traditional Chinese text.
reason: The new zh_CN totpStep1 "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：" uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式), while the rest of the file is Simplified (e.g. mobile=手机).

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text.
reason: Line 71 of the Lithuanian login bundle now has the Italian sentence for loginTotpStep1.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Account UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` to MessageFormat syntax.
reason: account-ui/src/i18n.ts loads the bundle into i18next with default interpolation, and ui-shared user-profile/utils.ts calls t(key, params). i18next only fills in {{0}}, so {0} and the choice clause will show up as raw text.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Admin UI message switched from i18next `{{0}}` to MessageFormat syntax.
reason: admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts also loads the bundle into plain i18next with default interpolation, and I found no server-side step that converts MessageFormat. The {0} and {2,choice,...} syntax will not be filled in.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Read errors in verifySafeHtml escape as RuntimeException and skip the MojoExecutionException handling.
reason: Every translated bundle seems to have a matching English file at the rewritten path. Even if one were missing, the build still fails; only the exception type differs. The trigger is hypothetical.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: The diff-trimming logic can overlap and throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
reason: With value "" and sanitized "", the loops on lines 102-109 give start=4 and end=5. sanitized.substring(4, 2) then throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of reporting the message.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Choice-format normalisation hides arbitrary HTML from the sanitizer check.
reason: Line 126 replaces each whole {n,choice,...} body with "..." before sanitizing, so markup inside a choice branch of these keys is never checked.

head: 02f48f776f43734d1ac8914d3ad6a7115acdcb33
title: Anchor error message omits the key and file, and the `key` parameter goes unused.
reason: This is only about the wording of a diagnostic message and an unused parameter; nothing breaks because of it.

head: ce2dcc537b4b1f98a335e88cfe8e0b804483252a
title: The test storage accepts any stored recovery code, never consumes it, and ignores the requested code number.
reason: BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage is a deliberately simple test stand-in (its isValid already accepts the hard-coded OTP "123456"), so loose recovery-code checking there only weakens the test fixture and is not a defect in the product.

head: ce2dcc537b4b1f98a335e88cfe8e0b804483252a
title: An exhausted recovery-codes credential from user storage is removed from local storage instead.
reason: RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential returns the user-storage credential first, but line 86 calls removeStoredCredentialById, which only reaches getStoreForUser(user).removeStoredCredential (local storage), so a used-up credential in the provider is never removed.

head: ce2dcc537b4b1f98a335e88cfe8e0b804483252a
title: Log message names the wrong credential type.
reason: Line 244 only has the wrong wording in a log message ("recovery-codes" and a double space), which is a remark, not a defect.

head: ce2dcc537b4b1f98a335e88cfe8e0b804483252a
title: `getCredentials` throws an NPE when the user is not in the storage map.
reason: Not every other method checks for null (disableCredentialType at lines 219-220 doesn't), and getCredentials is only called for users this provider serves, so in this test provider a missing user is not a realistic trigger.

head: 8ab88145113dd23a930e23b9cbbcf8b30e4c0b17
title: OptimizedCursorPaginator calls math.floor/ceil on a datetime and uses the raw cursor value as a datetime.
reason: get_item_key at lines 838-840 applies math.floor/ceil to getattr(item,'datetime'), a datetime, which raises TypeError in build_cursor; value_from_cursor returns the raw number, unlike DateTimePaginator.

head: 8ab88145113dd23a930e23b9cbbcf8b30e4c0b17
title: Negative cursor offsets are passed straight to a Django queryset slice.
reason: Lines 877-882 slice the queryset with a negative cursor.offset, and Django querysets raise on negative indexing, so a crafted cursor causes a 500.

head: 8ab88145113dd23a930e23b9cbbcf8b30e4c0b17
title: `organization_context.member` can be None, which makes every audit-log request crash.
reason: model.py:346 declares member as `RpcOrganizationMember | None = None`, and OrganizationAuditPermission admits org:write-scoped callers such as tokens, so line 71 `organization_context.member.has_global_access` can raise AttributeError on every request.

head: 8ab88145113dd23a930e23b9cbbcf8b30e4c0b17
title: Shared BasePaginator change lets negative offsets through for prev cursors.
reason: Before this change, offset went unclamped into the slice in both directions; line 182 now clamps the non-prev case, so the prev-cursor negative offset is pre-existing behaviour that the change does not make worse.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: Substring check treats negated or mixed event.type filters as error-only queries.
reason: Line 137 `if "event.type:error" in query` also matches `!event.type:error` and mixed OR queries, so count() is rewritten to sum(sample_weight) on discover rows that aren't errors.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: Adds an unrelated `sentry-repo` submodule pointer.
reason: The diff adds a gitlink `Subproject commit a5d29095…` at `sentry-repo` that points at an unrelated span-links commit; it is a stray nested checkout that changes how the repo clones.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: The 60-second eligibility cache keeps upsampling projects after they leave the allowlist, and the invalidation helper is never called.
reason: The 60s staleness is a deliberate choice explained in the docstring ("allowlist changes are infrequent and eventual consistency is acceptable") and in the commit message, and the suggested fix just undoes that choice.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: Docstring says the allowlist is read fresh each time, but the caller caches the result for 60 seconds.
reason: It only asks to reword a docstring (lines 50-53), which is a remark and not a defect.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: upsampled_count declares result type "number" although it returns toInt64 and stands in for count().
reason: It's true that `toInt64` returns an integer while the function declares `default_result_type="number"`; I didn't check whether the events-stats response takes its column type from this default, so a client-visible effect is unconfirmed.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: test_installation_not_found no longer tests the 404 path.
reason: The test sends the mismatched state 'ddd023…', so OAuthLoginView returns the generic error before build_integration runs; the 404 'installation could not be found' assertion was removed and that path is no longer tested.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: Direct indexing of `metadata["sender"]["login"]` can crash with a KeyError.
reason: build_integration only sets metadata['sender'] when state has a sender, which only the webhook (webhook.py:202-208) provides, so pipeline-created or older rows lack it and line 503 raises a KeyError.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: Error strings passed to `_()` as a variable are no longer picked up for translation.
reason: Line 141 `_(error_short)` wraps a variable, so makemessages cannot extract the short messages that were previously literal `_()` calls.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: Errors from `get_user_info` are not caught, so the user gets a 500 instead of the error page.
reason: get_user_info calls resp.raise_for_status() (identity/github/provider.py:16), and line 434 does not catch it, so a rejected token gives a 500.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: Network failures in the token exchange cause a 500 instead of the error page.
reason: safe_urlopen at line 423 sits outside the try/except, so a network failure during the token exchange reaches the user as a 500 instead of the error page.

head: 8422030ef456e3a898415e96475b4d8ddfc7640f
title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated.
reason: process_detectors has no callers under src/ and MetricAlertFire is referenced only at its own definition, so nothing instantiates the abstract MetricAlertDetectorHandler; the claimed crash has no trigger.

head: 8422030ef456e3a898415e96475b4d8ddfc7640f
title: The expected occurrence uses group key "val1" but the result being checked is for "group_key".
reason: IssueOccurrence.__eq__ (issue_occurrence.py:181-184) compares only `id`, and the mock gives both occurrences the same fixed id, so the fingerprint difference cannot make the assertion fail.

head: 8422030ef456e3a898415e96475b4d8ddfc7640f
title: The `evaluate` docstring still says it returns a list.
reason: An out-of-date docstring ('returns a list' at detector.py:230) is only wording; nothing breaks because of it.

head: 8422030ef456e3a898415e96475b4d8ddfc7640f
title: The expected values don't match the test data: group_2 is 10 but the expected occurrence uses 6.
reason: The finding itself says the tests pass because the mock builder ignores `value`; passing 6 instead of the input value is a style point about the tests, not a bug.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: A hung flusher process is never killed before a replacement starts.
reason: mp_context.Process builds a SpawnProcess, a subclass of BaseProcess but not of multiprocessing.Process, so the isinstance check at line 254 is always False and kill() never runs before the replacement process starts.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: `join` skips terminating the remaining processes once the deadline passes.
reason: The break at line 341 skips terminate() for the remaining processes, and the isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) check at line 346 never matches SpawnProcess anyway.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: The docstring says the flusher creates one process per shard, but `max_processes` caps that and the CLI default is 1.
reason: It only asks to reword the docstring at lines 31-32; this is a wording remark, not a defect.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: The `wait_produce` metric uses the tag `shards`, but the other flusher metrics use `shard`.
reason: Line 199 tags wait_produce with 'shards' while lines 185/195 use 'shard', so queries grouped or filtered by shard miss this metric.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: The added `time.sleep(0.1)` does nothing because the test replaces `time.sleep` with a no-op.
reason: Line 15 monkeypatches time.sleep to a no-op, so the added time.sleep(0.1) at line 62 is dead code that waits for nothing.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: CLAUDE.md guidance change is unrelated to the multiprocess flusher.
reason: It is a scope remark about a docs-only CLAUDE.md change that the PR summary lists, and nothing goes wrong because of it.

head: 3162ad68a5c87666788b27a44eb31235025091a9
title: A negative `--flusher-processes` value crashes the consumer at startup.
reason: A negative --flusher-processes is an operator misconfiguration of an internal CLI flag (consumers/__init__.py:433) that fails loudly at startup; this is a validation nicety rather than a defect introduced by the change.
